summary.intent: Debug 7 failing copilot-cli E2E tests in CI run #22747075400, fix root causes, and ship a clean PR with the fixes validated via targeted CI runs.
summary.outcome: All 7 original failures fixed via three root-cause fixes (copilot-instructions.md in test repos, env var forwarding into tmux, stripping CI env vars from tmux sessions) plus a transient-retry fix for gpt-4.1 Edit tool flakiness. PR #632 created; latest CI run showed 42/43 passing with the 1 failure being an unrelated corrupted installation on the CI runner.

repo: NewTmuxSession (e2e/agents/tmux.go) only auto-forwards PATH — all other agent-specific env vars must be passed explicitly through the command args
Every other interactive agent (droid, gemini, vogon, opencode) strips CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, and ENTIRE_TEST_TTY from tmux sessions; copilot-cli was missing this
IsTransientError only fires when err != nil — exit-0 silent failures require separate detection in RunPrompt that synthesizes an error before the retry mechanism can kick in
Agent-specific test repo setup pattern exists in SetupRepo: droid gets settings, opencode gets config, now copilot gets copilot-instructions.md
Copilot CLI v0.0.422 checks CI/GITHUB_ACTIONS env vars and disables its interactive TUI when they are set
Copilot CLI requires .github/copilot-instructions.md to be present or it blocks/degrades — even in non-interactive -p mode for tool calling quality

Copilot's Edit tool (gpt-4.1) sometimes self-corrects within a single session run, so old_str is required in stdout alone is insufficient to trigger retry — must also confirm Total code changes: +0 -0 in stderr
Non-interactive RunPrompt uses cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), ...) inheriting all env vars, but tmux sessions start fresh and only get what NewTmuxSession or the command args forward
The copilot-cli agent was added in a PR branch (b2a7603, alex/add-copilot-agent) that was not yet on main when the E2E framework worktree was checked out — needed to branch from that commit

code.finding: NewTmuxSession always prepends its own 'env PATH=...' wrapper around the command, meaning PATH gets forwarded twice when agents also explicitly include it in their env args — harmless since both values are identical, but redundant
SetupRepo has the pattern for agent-specific setup guarded by agent.Name() checks; added copilot-cli block to create .github/copilot-instructions.md in temp test repos

Synthetic error detection for silent success-with-no-changes: requires both 'old_str is required' in stdout AND 'Total code changes: +0 -0' in stderr before synthesizing an error — the dual condition prevents false positives when Copilot self-corrects

IsTransientError substring check for 'old_str is required' is broader than the RunPrompt check (no +0 -0 guard) — acceptable safety net but could theoretically false-positive if file content contains that string

Reference implementation for correct interactive agent env forwarding: explicitly forwards CURSOR_API_KEY, PATH, HOME, TERM, resolves binary to absolute path with exec.LookPath, strips CI vars via unsetEnv

workflow: git reset --soft HEAD~N restores the index from those N commits, clobbering any newer unstaged working tree edits — always stage new changes before squashing
In a git worktree, git add with repo-relative paths fails because the CWD differs; use absolute paths or check git status output for the actual relative path shown
Downloading CI artifacts into e2e/artifacts/ (tracked convention) makes them available for local inspection without repeated gh CLI calls

Local reproduction of CI interactive session bugs is unreliable when the root cause is env-dependent (CI vars, missing auth config) — a targeted CI run on the fix branch is faster than trying to exactly replicate CI locally
When a retry mechanism false-positives, the excess retries can hit rate limits and cause more failures than the original bug — validate retry conditions tightly before shipping

friction: Initial misdiagnosis as prompt regex mismatch wasted one analysis pass; the 'No copilot instructions found' notice was the real signal
Three separate CI runs needed to isolate root causes because local reproduction was impossible for the CI/GITHUB_ACTIONS stripping issue
git reset --soft squash lost the old_str retry code added after the squash — required an amend commit to recover
Relative path confusion in worktree caused git add to fail silently (path shown as ../agents/copilot-cli.go instead of e2e/agents/copilot-cli.go)
False-positive transient retry introduced in one commit caused 4 failures instead of 1 before being caught and fixed in the next commit
CI artifact download commands needed to be re-issued with correct target directory after user pointed out the e2e/artifacts convention
open_items: Token visibility in ps output: COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN passed via 'env KEY=VAL ...' args is visible in process list — flagged by Copilot bot but accepted as test infra in ephemeral CI runners
PATH is forwarded redundantly (once by NewTmuxSession automatically, once by explicit envArgs) — cosmetic, harmless, but slightly confusing
TestPartialStaging and similar tests remain potentially flaky for copilot-cli due to gpt-4.1 model non-determinism on old_str; the retry mechanism mitigates but doesn't eliminate
PR #632 is open and pending merge — one more clean CI run was triggered (22750328570) at session end to confirm
